summary: A Readymag page for Biceps Grotesk, a free modular display font by Together With You whose letters are built from octagon 'weights' and bars like dumbbells. Screen-sized crops of giant glyphs in red, magenta and maroon alternate with absurd AI photos of hyper-muscular bodybuilders slumped over office desks ('Conceived in an office, born in a gym'). A tiny fixed header carries the download link.

instances.look: The first two screens are pure glyph crops: huge overlapping letters of the name (B, i, c…) in bright red and magenta on dark red, built from octagon blobs joined by thick bars, cropped by every edge, under the tiny header text
instances.ux: static; only the header links (Download, togetherwithyou.co)
instances.learn: Crop the letters so large that only their modules show: the construction system (octagon 'weights' + bars) becomes the hero image

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×900 per screen; 3–4 glyphs each ~900–1200px tall overlapping, layered by colour; header text 11px along the top edge
reconstruction.typography: Biceps Grotesk glyphs as SVG at ~1000px; header ~11px uppercase grotesk

instances.look: Not cut as a block: a fixed strip of tiny uppercase text across the top of every screen: 'BICEPS GROTESK / 100% FREE DISPLAY FONT BY TOGETHER WITH YOU', a magenta 'DOWNLOAD / FONT VERSION 1.0 / 2024', 'VISUALS MADE TOGETHER WITH BENGT TIBERT / FOLLOW US & BENGT EVERYWHERE', a dark round logo dot and 'TOGETHERWITHYOU.CO'
instances.ux: Fixed; Download links to a Google Drive zip
instances.learn: Keep the chrome microscopic so the giant glyphs own the screen

reconstruction.layout: Five text groups spread across the 1440px width, ~16px from the top; logo dot ~40px
reconstruction.typography: ~11px uppercase grotesk, two lines each, maroon; Download in magenta

instances.look: Full-width photographs with no type: grotesquely over-muscled bodybuilders in fluorescent-lit offices and kitchens (a crowd flexing among office chairs, a torso folded over mugs, a man crossing gigantic arms by a printer, a body swollen into a muscle blob over a desk, a row of muscle mounds on a workbench); one is a Vimeo video with a play button
instances.ux: Pauses between glyph screens; the video plays on click
instances.learn: Pair a modular 'dumbbell' font with a single absurd visual metaphor (offices full of bodybuilders): the joke carries the concept between specimens

reconstruction.layout: Full-width 1440px images ~470–900px tall, butting against coloured glyph panels; video embed same size
reconstruction.typography: none (only the fixed header over the image)
reconstruction.assets: AI-assisted or composited photos by Bengt Tibert; one video

instances.look: Under the video, three short paragraphs in tiny maroon caps on red, almost camouflaged: how the letters are made (each from squares or triangles on an 810×810 frame with a 30px grid, inspired by a dumbbell), that the font is 100% free, and an invitation to share work
instances.learn: State the construction rule in numbers (810×810 frame, 30px grid, squares and triangles): it tells designers how the modular letters fit together

reconstruction.layout: Full-width text block ~1400px, 3 paragraphs, 10px gaps, directly under the video

instances.look: The whole set as running lines in maroon on red at ~100px: 'AaBbCcDdEeFfGgHhIi…', 'JjKkLlMmNnOoPpQqRr', 'rSsTtUuVvWwXxYy', then figures and punctuation '1234567890.,?;!:'"([{}–-…/|&*@#$%^_`+='
instances.learn: A small display set reads best as full-width lines at display size, case pairs side by side

reconstruction.layout: Full width, 5 lines ~110px tall, tight leading, flush left with ~20px margin

instances.look: 'BICepS / GR / OtE / sK' stacked at ~350px in maroon on red, the name broken across four lines so it fills the screen
instances.learn: Break the name wherever it fills the line best: the modular letters hold together even when the word does not

reconstruction.layout: Four lines full width, ~280px leading, letters touching

instances.look: A run of screen-sized compositions: single glyphs cropped huge (S, K, G, R, 8) in magenta, bright red or maroon on contrasting fields, split two-up panels with the caption 'BICEPS GROTESK 100% FREE FONT BY TOGETHER WITH YOU. CONCEIVED IN AN OFFICE, BORN IN A GYM.' and a round logo, cards with 'BICEPS GROTESK' plus the set in magenta, and a paragraph 'Lifting weights is excellent for your muscles…' set in the font
instances.learn: Re-colour the same three-colour palette in every combination: one glyph per poster keeps a single-weight display font interesting for twenty screens

reconstruction.layout: Each 1440×900 screen: either one glyph ~900px cropped, or two 720px panels each with a caption row (~70px) and a glyph; logo ~40px in the panel corner
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs ~800–1000px Biceps Grotesk; captions ~14px uppercase grotesk; paragraph ~30px Biceps Grotesk

instances.ux: Links to a Google Drive file; free for commercial and personal use
instances.learn: For a free font, ask for a tag in return: the download line doubles as the community call

instances.look: Three columns of tiny maroon caps on red, shown twice (after the character set and at the very end): download/Instagram request; 'CREDITS' (Idea, design, art direction: Together With You, Artem Tarasov, Artem Taradash; Visuals & videos: Bengt Tibert; Typography advisor: Liza Rasskazova, Contrast Foundry; Motion & graphic design: Andrey Ostapenko); 'FOLLOW' (Instagram, X, Behance links); then 'CONCEIVED IN AN OFFICE, BORN IN A GYM' and '© 2024 TOGETHER WITH YOU'
